whenToUse: One web order: fulfilment steps, line items with VAT, payment ledger and carrier label.
Issuing partial refunds per unit with the ledger updated straight away.
avoidWhen: Building a quote or proposal — use detail-08.
Order queues across many orders — use dashboard-08.
a11y: Line items are a table; refund totals update in an aria-live region.
Unit pickers in the refund dialog are grouped (role="group") with labels per line.
